question: How long do I bake the banana bread and at what temperature?
page:
Easy Banana Bread
Ingredients: 3 ripe bananas, 1/3 cup melted butter, 3/4 cup sugar, 1 egg, 1 tsp baking soda, 1.5 cups flour.
Steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350F. 2. Mash bananas, mix in butter. 3. Add sugar, egg, soda, flour. 4. Pour into a greased loaf pan. 5. Bake 55 to 65 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
